integrity: Complete seven-column integer determinant enumeration and exact polynomial identity are supplied in a standalone checker; infinite weight optimization is proved analytically. The previously published equal-weight ratio 28/27 is credited to its source. Priority is bounded by the named and inspected literature; no independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula and sharp 25/24 maximum concern a five-dimensional fixed reduced-incidence realization, two fixed orthogonal projection directions, and positive edge weights constant along each of three specified theta-graph paths. No claim over arbitrary edge weights, graphs, or projection directions, or over degenerate edge weights, is made.
title: A sharp path-weight projection violation for the theta-graph zonotope
